representativeExamples.note: Page example: 10M, 12 months, 1.41%/month ('16.92%/năm'), 974,000/month, total 11,692,000. 16.92 = 1.41 x 12 is a nominal figure, NOT an effective APR. Figures are consistent with flat interest on original principal (10M/12 + 1.41% x 10M = 974,333), but the page does not say so, and T&C 4.2/4.5 say interest accrues daily on actual outstanding principal and a converted rate is for reference only. Basis left unknown.

researchNotes: 1) data/licensed-institutions.json did NOT exist in the repo when this was written, so licensing was NOT checked against it; legal name comes from the lender's own T&C PDF. Must be verified against the SBV list. 2) No loan fee schedule (biểu phí) or rate table is published for cash/installment loans; only credit cards have per-card biểu phí pages (not read). Early-repayment and late fees have no published amounts. 3) Rate basis: motorbike/phone FAQs say interest is on dư nợ ban đầu (flat), but T&C 4.2/4.5 (effective 14/08/2026) say interest accrues daily on actual outstanding principal (365-day year) and the converted rate is for reference only. The cash-loan page never states basis; its worked example matches flat arithmetic. Unverified. 4) Cash loan term conflict (6-36 FAQ vs 3-60 calculator); phone loan rate conflict (0-2.69 vs 1.41-3.86). 5) Calculator shows 19.000.000 VND monthly (page bug). 6) Insurance is stated optional but premium ratio unpublished and timing (deducted vs financed) unclear. 7) Other products not captured: FE Paylater (Mua trước trả sau, 0% up to 45 days, age 20-60, income 3M; fee PDF not read), B@W. 8) $NAP app not found on official pages. 9) Only first 100,000 of about 280,000 characters of each product page were read. Third-party articles gave different rates (e.g. 2.17-2.83%/month) and were not used.
